scheduleNotes.title: First instructional day · Tue Sep 8
scheduleNotes.body: School calendar lists first day Tue Sep 8 (new PreK/K start Wed Sep 9). Thu Sep 3 orientation is Grade 5 and new students only.

scheduleNotes.title: Bus on delays and closures
scheduleNotes.body: 2-hour delay → 9:20am pickup. If SOMSD or Morris SD is closed, the Maplewood bus does not run even if Red Oaks is open.

needsResponse.title: Pick up one teacher welcome letter
needsResponse.body: Last day. File box near the main entrance on Virginia Road. One letter per Bolden student.
needsResponse.location: File box near the main entrance, Virginia Road

needsResponse.title: Add PaySchools meal funds
needsResponse.body: Theo meal balance is still −$6.70 (below the $5 alert). Breakfast starts today at 7:15am and costs $2.15. Add funds in PaySchools Central.

needsResponse.title: Get teacher assignment in PowerSchool
needsResponse.body: Posted Friday Aug 28. School is at capacity and will not honor class-change requests. Portal help: ParentPortalHelp@somsd.k12.nj.us.

upcoming.title: First day of school
upcoming.body: 7:50am–2:20pm. Arrive no earlier than 7:40am. 3rd grade lines up in the gym. Car drop-off is Maryland Road (Virginia Road is buses/staff only 7:30–8:00am). Dismissal 2:20pm on the front lawn facing Ridgewood Road. Universal breakfast 7:15am via the rear door off the parking lot; escort kids on Maryland Road. Phones, smartwatches, and earbuds banned bell-to-bell. Chromebooks stay at school.

upcoming.title: Coffee with Calissi
upcoming.body: Listed on the Bolden PTA calendar at 7:50am. No extra details in district mail.

upcoming.title: Back-to-School Night
upcoming.body: 6:30pm. That day is a 4-hour day for students; dismissal 11:50am.

scheduleNotes.title: First day · Tue Sep 1
scheduleNotes.body: Hours 7:50am–2:20pm; do not arrive before 7:40am. 3rd grade lines up in the gym after drop-off on Virginia or Maryland. Car families: Maryland Road only 7:30–8:00am. Breakfast 7:15am, $2.15, rear door off the parking lot. Dismissal 2:20pm, front lawn facing Ridgewood Road. Virginia Road closed to through traffic 2:00–2:30pm.

scheduleNotes.title: Wed Sep 23 early dismissal
scheduleNotes.body: Back-to-School Night evening. Students dismiss at 11:50am (4-hour day).

scheduleNotes.title: District mail
scheduleNotes.body: Expect school mail from somsd.k12.nj.us. First-day letter: https://drive.google.com/file/d/14GCg2DbFAaWJXe2bQvNlmD6cbjjQnAi5/view
